page_topic_one_liner: Web crawlers — search bots vs AI bots, robots.txt tokens, crawl vs index vs train vs retrieve, and bot traffic management
differentiator_vs_generic: This is crawler infrastructure and robots.txt policy education. Hero must show robots.txt user-agent lanes feeding into a site map crawl diagram (Googlebot path vs GPTBot path) — NOT an LLM chat panel as the primary visual even though AI crawlers are discussed.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Split crawl-path diagram — left: robots.txt snippet card with User-agent lines (Googlebot / GPTBot / Bingbot blurred), center: website node graph with URL nodes, right: two diverging bot lanes — search crawler lane (JS render icon) vs AI training crawler lane (HTML-only icon) — accent highlights the policy fork
Secondary: server log tail fragment showing bot hit frequency bars by user-agent (blurred labels, bar heights only)
Tertiary: small noindex vs Disallow warning badge — crossed misconfiguration arrow (visual metaphor only, no explanatory text block)
anti_patterns: OpenAI/Anthropic product UI or chat window dominating canvas
Generic spider mascot cartoon without robots.txt or crawl graph
